messages:
alejandra: Heads-up  found a mismatch between the deprecation notice and the migration guide. The notice mentions endpoint rename only; it doesn't call out the error contract change (v1 status codes -> v2 structured error.code). We should coordinate comms + snippets.
tom: Agree. We need a short 'what changed' bullet in the deprecation email and a one-paragraph FAQ entry for customers using custom retry logic.
rachel: I'll draft the PR to docs: add FAQ, mapping table, and two tiny snippets (py/ts) showing v2-first error checks with legacy fallback for one release. Also add a section for enterprise customers that need longer migration windows.
sam: Add smoke-tests to snippets CI so the examples run against the staging runtime. I'll create a tiny job that runs the py/ts commands in dry-mode. QA-bot can pick it up.
docs-bot: Use docs PR template and include `docs: deprecate v1 - error contract note` in the title.
qa-bot: I can run the smoke tests and report failures to this thread. Please include exact commands in PR.
alejandra: Timeline: draft PR today, request reviews tomorrow, aim to merge before Wed 05:00 UTC rollout. I'll also update the deprecation email draft with the new bullets and ping comms.
tom: Assign reviewers: @rachel (author), @sam (snippets/CI), @alejandra (comm/email). Rachel, ping when PR is up and we'll triage any feedback quickly.
rachel: Opening PR now with checklist: mapping table, FAQ section, py/ts snippets, CI smoke job, update deprecation email. Will tag reviewers and include test commands.
sam: Thanks — I'll stand by to add CI job once PR has commands.
